strategies.statement: Treat data as a product — each domain publishes data assets consumed by the rest of the business
strategies.driver: Data is the second-most expensive asset and frequently the least managed; consumers cannot rely on what they cannot inspect
strategies.target-outcome: Top 30 data assets published as discoverable, versioned products with SLAs by end of 2026

strategies.statement: Federate data ownership to domain teams; centralise only standards and platform
strategies.driver: Central data teams become bottlenecks and lose subject-matter context; pure decentralisation creates incompatible silos
strategies.target-outcome: Every data product has a named domain owner; a single self-service platform with shared standards by 2026

strategies.statement: Default to self-service; specialist data teams support domains, not gate them
strategies.driver: Ticket-based data access models scale poorly and breed shadow data pipelines
strategies.target-outcome: 80% of analytics use cases satisfied without bespoke pipeline work; specialist teams allocated to platform improvements

strategies.statement: Privacy and consent are designed in, not bolted on
strategies.driver: GDPR, CCPA, and equivalent regimes treat privacy failures as systemic, not isolated
strategies.target-outcome: All personal-data flows traceable to a consent record; data classifications enforced at storage and access

strategies.statement: Move to real-time data where it changes a decision; keep batch where it doesn't
strategies.driver: Real-time is expensive; applying it indiscriminately wastes money. Withholding it where the decision is time-sensitive loses value
strategies.target-outcome: Stream-first architecture for time-sensitive domains (trading, network ops, customer engagement); batch retained for periodic reporting

strategies.statement: Lineage and provenance are non-negotiable for every data product
strategies.driver: Decisions made on data of unknown provenance cannot be defended or improved
strategies.target-outcome: End-to-end lineage available for every published data product; automated provenance metadata captured at point of production

activity.notes: Reviewed and refined during the 2026-Q1 architecture cycle.
